messages.author: 14f16be058072eb4
messages.subject: Inserting figures with captions
parts:
Hi,

I thought this topic had been posted already, but I didn't find it.

I'm quite a knitr newbie, and I'm struggling with figures and captions:

Here is a really simple .Rnw

\documentclass[a4paper]{article}
\usepackage[american]{babel}

\begin{document}

\title{Simple regression}
\author{Me}
\maketitle

\section{Introduction}
Some text here...

\section{Simple regression}

Some text here...

<<code1>>=
n <- 1e2
x <- rnorm(n)
y <- x+rnorm(n, 0, .2)
@

Some other text...

<<simpleReg, fig.height=3.5, fig.width=4>>=
plot(x, y)
abline(lm(y~x))
@

Some comment here...

\end{document}

Everything works fine here, but
- if I add fig.cap="Some caption", then the figure is displayed at the end of the doc.
- If I add include=FALSE, there is no figure, at all, and this part of code is hidden.

So, how to combine the chunk options to get the code and the figure+caption at the right place in the doc ?

Thanks

messages.author: d588a03e58ea7e7f
messages.subject: Re: Inserting figures with captions
parts:
On 4/26/2014 12:31 PM, Fred Commo wrote:
> Hi,
>
> I thought this topic had been posted already, but I didn't find it.
>
> I'm quite a knitr newbie, and I'm struggling with figures and captions:
>
> Here is a really simple .Rnw
>
> \documentclass[a4paper]{article}
> \usepackage[american]{babel}
>
> \begin{document}
>
> \title{Simple regression}
> \author{Me}
> \maketitle
>
> \section{Introduction}
> Some text here...
>
> \section{Simple regression}
>
> Some text here...
>
> <<code1>>=
> n <- 1e2
> x <- rnorm(n)
> y <- x+rnorm(n, 0, .2)
> @
>
> Some other text...
>
> <<simpleReg, fig.height=3.5, fig.width=4>>=
> plot(x, y)
> abline(lm(y~x))
> @
>
> Some comment here...
>
> \end{document}
>
> Everything works fine here, but
> - if I add fig.cap="Some caption", then the figure is displayed at the end
> of the doc.
> - If I add include=FALSE, there is no figure, at all, and this part of code
> is hidden.
>
> So, how to combine the chunk options to get the code and the figure+caption
> at the right place in the doc ?

Not to sound flippant, but what do you mean by "right place"? I assume
you mean right where the code chunk is. However, LaTeX, by default would
not agree with that. One of the features of LaTeX is the ability to have
"floating" figures. Rather than appearing exactly where they are
included, a float (figure, table, etc.) can float to somewhere else such
as the bottom of the page, the top of the next page, or on a page by
itself. Without a caption, figures are not put inside a figure
environment (which is a floating environment) and so appear exactly
where the code chunk is. But adding a caption triggers them being put
inside a figure (floating) environment and thus going where LaTeX things
is best. You can add the chunk option `fig.pos = "H"` which tells LaTeX
that the best place is right here and nowhere else. This also requires
including the LaTeX package float (add `\usepackage{float}` to the
document preamble.


> Thanks

--Brian Diggs

messages.subject: Re: Inserting figures with captions
parts:
Hi Brian,

Thanks a lot for this nice and clear explanation! Everything works (almost) fine now.

where can I get the different options, and their posiible values as well ?
For instance, what are the other possible options for fig.pos ? How to reduce the spacing between the outputs ?
Here, the plot is displayed at the right place, but there is a huge empty space I would like to remove.

Thanks
Fred

messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Re: Inserting figures with captions
parts: Really, you need to study LaTeX, and then look at the chunk options for knitr at http://yahui.name/knitr/options. The key to success is to understand that you are writing LaTeX, and knitr is just helping you a bit.
